# rmux 0.1.21
Improve link hover feedback, tab zoom, and Claude Code workspace status.
- Hold Cmd on macOS or Ctrl on Linux/Windows while hovering a link to underline its visible text, including wrapped URLs and OSC 8 labels. The destination appears at the bottom of the terminal pane instead of in a popup. - Double-click a terminal tab to toggle pane zoom within the window. Rename remains available from the tab context menu. - Local shell integration launches Claude Code with session-local hooks for working, approval, completion, and error states in tabs and the workspace sidebar, plus completion and approval notifications. Existing Claude settings files and user shell aliases/functions are preserved. - Use `rmuxctl claude` explicitly when needed, or set `RMUX_CLAUDE_INTEGRATION=0` to opt out. Print mode, redirected output, and explicit `--settings` arguments pass through unchanged. - Includes the Cmd+K fix shipped in 0.1.20, with its regression checks reverified.
Addresses [#13](https://github.com/rmuxapp/rmux/issues/13), [#14](https://github.com/rmuxapp/rmux/issues/14), and [#15](https://github.com/rmuxapp/rmux/issues/15).
## Downloads
Signed and notarized macOS Apple Silicon DMG and ZIP, Linux x86-64 tarball, and Windows x86-64 ZIP. macOS updates use Sparkle. All release builds run on GitHub.
Validation: 149 active terminal tests and 37 CLI tests passed, along with the desktop debug build, live RPC smoke checks, shell integration checks, and Claude lifecycle fixtures covering Ctrl+C, cleanup, exit status, aliases, and passthrough. The CLI cross-check for Windows passed. Native visual verification was blocked by the locked Mac; native Windows runtime validation remains deferred.
